20261103WA85158.description: Washington Initiative 1. Restores a school parental rights law.
20261103WA85158.summary: This ballot measure would restore a school parental rights law to the version originally passed in 2024, including parents' rights to prior notification about medical services and to review their child's school records within 10 business days of a request.

20261103WA85159.description: Washington Initiative 638. Bars biological males from competing in school sports for females.
20261103WA85159.summary: This ballot measure would prohibit biological males from competing in school sports reserved for females and require students to provide a signed statement from a healthcare provider verifying their biological sex based on reproductive anatomy, genetic makeup or natural testosterone levels.
20261103WA85159.seatName: 638 - Require school sports participation based on biological sex

20261103WA85160.description: Washington Initiative 645. Repeals a state income tax on millionaires.
20261103WA85160.summary: This ballot measure would repeal a 9.9% state tax on individual income over $1 million.

20261103WA85218.description: Seattle Proposition 1. Raises the sales tax for transit service to 0.3% for up to 10 years.
20261103WA85218.summary: This ballot measure would replace Seattle's voter-approved 0.15% sales tax for transit, which expires March 31, 2027, with a 0.3% sales and use tax for up to 10 years to fund more frequent transit service, affordable fare programs, RapidRide and other service enhancements, reliability, access and climate projects, and Sound Transit expansion.
20261103WA85218.seatName: Seattle 1 - Raise sales tax for transit funding
